item.title: 1: Tasks
item.text:
For this lablet, fix the failing CI/CD pipeline that deploys OSPF/NTP/VLAN changes. The last run failed due to a missing interface configuration, OSPF not converged, and artifacts not preserved. Search the files below for the sections marked #TODO. These are the only sections that should be modified in the code to fix the pipeline. 

Workstation Credentials: username:cisco, password:cisco

Task 1: Open the .gitlab-ci.yml file in the CandidateTasks folder on the desktop and complete the #TODO note in the code.

Task 2: Open the scripts/deploy.py file in the scripts folder and complete the five #TODO notes in the code. 

Task 3: Open the scripts/post_validate.py file and complete the two #TODO notes in the code.

Task 4: Commit the changes to GitLab-CE Candidate Tasks repository with a "fixed" message and push. The repository is already cloned to GitLab-CE. You can commit changes using either the workstation's terminal or the VS Code terminal. If committing from the VS Code terminal, set Git identity first: git config --global user.name "root" and git config --global user.email "gitlab_admin_b63792@example.com".

Task 5: Confirm that the latest pipeline succeeds for all stages. You can achieve this by either opening the GitLab-CE Candidate Tasks repository using the bookmark in the browser (username: root, password: Cisc01@3) or by running python scripts/post_validate.py.
